Hi Christine — thanks for sending this over and for attaching the invoice. A couple of quick items from our side before we can release the tax hold: 

- On the attached PA resale form the seller name is listed as "Redwood". For PA sales tax purposes we need the seller name to match our legal vendor name on file: "Redwood Inference, LLC".
- The form is missing the Pennsylvania tax ID / account number field filled in (PA often requires either the purchaser's PA account or clear reseller indication).

Because of those items our billing team has the invoice on a temporary tax hold. If you can resend an updated PA resale certificate with the seller name exactly as "Redwood Inference, LLC" and include either BrightMetrics' PA account number or an explicit reseller statement in the form, that should clear it.

If it's easier, we can accept a notarized or scanned copy showing the corrected seller name; we just need the document to match the invoice vendor line and include the purchaser identifier.

Marissa — looping you in to keep an eye on invoice 7843 once Christine confirms. Priyom, tagging you in case there are any legal nuances we should accept as alternate proof.
